description: Ownership classifications only. Not a live payroll, attendance or worker payments feed.

subjects.name: Reviewed field & desk documents
subjects.custody: Edited in the existing Google Sheet; original files and permissions remain in Drive.
subjects.integration: Approved source-readback rows publish the document index; the external source file metadata is not independently re-fetched in this workflow.
subjects.limit: A public link does not certify drawing approval or give access to a restricted original.

subjects.name: Fishtail manpower, wages & attendance
subjects.authority: Immutable original Wage List 11 workbook; independently scoped M01, M02 and M03 locked baselines
subjects.custody: Retain permanent original identities and M01/M02/M03 evidence, rules and manifests.
subjects.integration: No live, authenticated GitHub Actions read of this private source has been established.
subjects.limit: Locked analytical reports are not live operational payroll records.

subjects.name: Worker Money & Goods
subjects.authority: Existing per-worker Google Sheets with separate prototype and historical backups
subjects.custody: Original 24-item collection (W01–W21, separate W01 hardened prototype and backups) moved 11 November 2026 to 01_JP / 02 Website Sheets and Registers / 06 Finance and Purchasing / 09 Restricted Workforce Source Registers. Original IDs, histories and observed permission set preserved.
subjects.integration: No authenticated private worker transaction read by public Pages. Operational rollout unverified final; original worker tabs differ in structure.
subjects.limit: The source authority register says the 21-worker operational rollout is not verified as final.

subjects.name: Wage List 11 cleaning & conversion
subjects.authority: Original Fishtail Wage List 11 remains governing source; conversions are historic derivatives.
subjects.custody: Keep clean attendance, work, wage and payment conversions with their preparation history.
subjects.integration: Quality review and historical lineage only.
subjects.limit: A cleaned conversion does not replace the original or establish current worker attendance.

subjects.name: Tools, equipment & material registers
subjects.authority: To be confirmed by each approved field and project owner
subjects.custody: Stable resource/project IDs, observed quantity, revision, custodian, location and approval.
subjects.integration: Send only approved non-personal aggregates into scheduling and estimation.
subjects.limit: No verified live field inventory or tool assignment source is connected.

subjects.name: Site forms, evidence, checklists & manuals
subjects.authority: Original issued site/desk reference and captured evidence
subjects.custody: Track issue/revision date, owner, source and approval separately.
subjects.integration: Publish only permitted references and links; original record stays with its issuer.
subjects.limit: A file link is not proof of signed inspection or completed work.

consumers.policy: Validated aggregate labour costs and materials; never source employee attendance or individual advances.
Approved workforce capacity and productivity inputs, dated and source-attributed.
Approved project/day progress and resource summaries, not worker payment ledgers.
